a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 will almost certainly leave us both empty when the storm comes. I intend to take from the reserve in round 1 rather than operate. I'm telling you now so you can decide your own move with full information. If you want to propose a different split, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
